mapper.select: SELECT e.calc_accounting_class AS accountingClass, SUM(e.amount) AS actualAmount, COALESCE(SUM(bd.budget_amount), 0) AS budgetAmount, COALESCE(SUM(bd.budget_amount), 0) - SUM(e.amount) AS varianceAmount FROM fee_expense_bill e LEFT JOIN budget_preparation_detail bd ON bd.subject_code = e.calc_budget_subject AND bd.dept_id = e.dept_id AND YEAR(bd.create_time) = #{year} AND MONTH(bd.create_time) = #{month} WHERE e.status = 'APPROVED' AND YEAR(e.expense_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(e.expense_date) = #{month} GROUP BY e.calc_accounting_class ORDER BY FIELD(e.calc_accounting_class, 'ASSET','LIABILITY','EQUITY','INCOME','COST','EXPENSE')

SELECT e.id, e.bill_no AS billNo, e.dept_id AS deptId, sd.dept_name AS deptName, e.applicant_id AS applicantId, e.applicant_name AS applicantName, e.item_category AS itemCategory, e.purpose_tag AS purposeTag, pt.tag_name AS purposeTagName, e.project_code AS projectCode, e.calc_budget_subject AS calcBudgetSubject, bs.subject_name AS calcBudgetSubjectName, e.calc_accounting_class AS calcAccountingClass, e.amount, e.expense_date AS expenseDate, e.expense_period AS expensePeriod, e.is_fixed_asset AS isFixedAsset, e.expenditure_type AS expenditureType, e.is_over_budget AS isOverBudget, e.over_budget_approval_id AS overBudgetApprovalId, e.status, e.allocation_status AS allocationStatus, e.remark, e.create_by AS createBy, e.create_time AS createTime, e.update_by AS updateBy, e.update_time AS updateTime FROM fee_expense_bill e LEFT JOIN sys_dept sd ON e.dept_id = sd.dept_id LEFT JOIN fee_purpose_tag pt ON e.purpose_tag = pt.tag_code LEFT JOIN budget_subject bs ON e.calc_budget_subject = bs.subject_code ${ew.customSqlSegment} ORDER BY e.create_time DESC

SELECT e.id, e.bill_no AS billNo, e.dept_id AS deptId, e.item_category AS itemCategory, e.purpose_tag AS purposeTag, e.amount, e.expense_date AS expenseDate, e.allocation_status AS allocationStatus, e.status FROM fee_expense_bill e WHERE e.allocation_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY e.expense_date DESC

SELECT e.calc_budget_subject AS subjectCode, bs.subject_name AS subjectName, bs.subject_type AS subjectType, SUM(e.amount) AS totalAmount FROM fee_expense_bill e LEFT JOIN budget_subject bs ON e.calc_budget_subject = bs.subject_code WHERE e.dept_id = #{deptId} AND e.status = 'APPROVED' AND YEAR(e.expense_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(e.expense_date) = #{month} AND e.calc_budget_subject IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.calc_budget_subject, bs.subject_name, bs.subject_type
